# PRP — P1.M3.T3.S1: Nudge A (tool_result annotator) + turn_end metric (Phase 1) + shouldNudge/injectNudge/suppressCheck (Phase 2)

## Goal

**Feature Goal:** Ship Mulligan's two zero-extra-request "ride-along" nudges end-to-end. (A) A `tool_result` handler appends a bloat reminder to large results and records the hit. (B-phase1) A `turn_end` handler measures each turn's token delta + bloat and persists a `mulligan:turn-metric`. (B-phase2) Pure `shouldNudge`/`injectNudge`/`suppressCheck` helpers, wired into `filter.ts`'s `contextHandler`, inject an EPHEMERAL `mulligan:nudge` (never persisted) on the next inference when drift/bloat warrants and the agent hasn't already self-corrected.

**Deliverable:** `src/nudges.ts` (replacing the `export {};` stub) exporting the two Pi-coupled handlers + 3 pure helpers + 2 register functions + `NUDGE_TURN_WINDOW_MS`; a small EXTENSION to `src/filter.ts` (the injection callsite after `filterPipeline`); a small EXTENSION to `src/runtime.ts` (add `pendingBloatHits`); plus 3 new vitest suites (`test/nudges.test.ts`, `test/turn_metric.test.ts`, `test/drift_nudge.test.ts`) and an update to `test/runtime.test.ts`.

**Success Definition:** (1) A bloated tool_result (>8KB) gets the `[mulligan]` reminder appended and the turn-metric records `bloatHit:true`. (2) A turn that grew >3000 tokens causes the next `context.fire` to return messages ending in an ephemeral `mulligan:nudge` custom message, while ZERO `mulligan:nudge` entries are ever written to the session (no `pi.sendMessage`). (3) A rewind/shrink created during the metric's turn SUPPRESSES the nudge. (4) Everything is fail-open; the full green test suite stays green.

## Why

- **D4 (the project's central constraint):** any per-turn nudge MUST ride an inference that was already happening. Both nudges piggyback events that fire anyway (`tool_result`, `turn_end`, `context`) — zero extra model requests.
- **Feedback loop closure:** without these nudges the agent has no automatic signal that a result is bloated or a turn drifted — it would only discover bloat by luck. The bloat reminder is co-located with the offending output; the drift nudge is a one-line annotation on the next inference.
- **Advisory by design (D3):** nudges never force behavior or auto-shrink (which would risk discarding data the model needs now). They point at `mulligan_shrink`/`mulligan_rewind`/`mulligan_audit`.

## What

**User-visible behavior:** (1) When a tool result exceeds `bloatThresholdBytes` (default 8192 bytes), the result the model receives gains a trailing reminder block pointing at shrink/rewind. (2) After a turn that grew context past `driftThresholdTokens` (default 3000) OR produced a bloated result, the model's NEXT inference sees a one-line `[mulligan] Previous turn added ~Xk tokens…` annotation appended to its context copy. (3) If the agent already rewound/shrunk during that turn, the nudge is suppressed (no nagging).

**Technical surface:** two Pi event handlers (`tool_result`, `turn_end`), three pure helpers (`shouldNudge`, `injectNudge`, `suppressCheck`), one filter.ts extension, one runtime.ts field. The drift nudge is constructed INLINE in the filter and is NEVER appended to the session.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] `bloatReminderHandler(event, ctx)` appends `renderBloatReminder(...)` to content (APPEND, not replace) when `resultBytes(content) >= config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes`; skips `mulligan_*` tools; pushes one entry to `rt.pendingBloatHits`; returns `{content}`; no-ops under both config gates; fail-open.
- [ ] `turnEndMetricHandler(pi, event, ctx)` computes `now`/`delta`/bloat, builds the 5-field `TurnMetricInput`, calls `appendTurnMetric`, rolls `rt.tokenBaseline`/`rt.lastTurnIndex`, clears `rt.pendingBloatHits`; fail-open.
- [ ] `shouldNudge(metric, config)` returns `metric.grewOverThreshold || metric.bloatHit` (pure boolean; both arms OR'd per contract).
- [ ] `suppressCheck(metric, markers)` returns true iff some rewind/shrink marker `ts` is in `(metric.ts − NUDGE_TURN_WINDOW_MS, metric.ts]` (pure; window not upper-bound, to avoid over-suppress).
- [ ] `injectNudge(messages, metric)` returns a NEW `[...messages, nudge]` with an ephemeral `mulligan:nudge` custom message; NEVER calls `pi.sendMessage`; input unmutated.
- [ ] `contextHandler` injects the nudge after `filterPipeline` iff `perTurnDrift && metric && shouldNudge && !suppressCheck`; caches result in `rt.lastFiltered`; fail-open unchanged.
- [ ] `pendingBloatHits: {toolName:string; approxTokens:number}[]` added to `SessionRuntime` (init `[]`); `test/runtime.test.ts` updated (key count 6→7; the `.not.toHaveProperty("pendingBloatHits")` assertion flipped to `.toHaveProperty`).
- [ ] ZERO `mulligan:nudge` entries persisted across all scenarios (assert the fake-pi's `sendMessage` is never called with `customType:"mulligan:nudge"`).
- [ ] Per-tool-bloat-threshold noted in code as a known future enhancement (NOT implemented).

```typescript
export function bloatReminderHandler(event: ToolResultEvent, ctx: ExtensionContext): { content?: ToolResultContentBlock[] } | void {
  let sessionId = "";
  try {
    sessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();              
    const config = getConfig();
    if (!config.enabled || !config.nudges.bloatReminder) return; 
    const tn = event.toolName;
    if (typeof tn === "string" && tn.startsWith("mulligan_")) return;
    const bytes = resultBytes(event.content as unknown as ResultContentBlock[]);
    if (bytes < config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes) return;       
    const reminder = renderBloatReminder(event.toolName, bytes, config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes);
    const content: ToolResultContentBlock[] = [...event.content, { type: "text", text: reminder }]; 
    const rt = runtime(ctx.sessionManager);
    rt.pendingBloatHits.push({ toolName: event.toolName, approxTokens: approxTokens(bytes) }); 
    return { content };
  } catch (e) {
    logError("nudge.bloat", sessionId, { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }); 
  }
}
export function turnEndMetricHandler(pi: ExtensionAPI, event: TurnEndEvent, ctx: ExtensionContext): void {
  let sessionId = "";
  try {
    sessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
    const config = getConfig();
    if (!config.enabled || !config.nudges.perTurnDrift) return;
    const rt = runtime(ctx.sessionManager);
    const now = rt.lastFiltered ? estimateTokens(rt.lastFiltered).tokens : (ctx.getContextUsage()?.tokens ?? 0);
    const delta = rt.tokenBaseline == null ? null : now - rt.tokenBaseline;
    const bloat = rt.pendingBloatHits; rt.pendingBloatHits = [];   
    appendTurnMetric(pi, ctx, {
      deltaTokens: delta, bloatHit: bloat.length > 0, bloatHits: bloat,
      grewOverThreshold: delta != null && delta > config.nudges.driftThresholdTokens, turnIndex: event.turnIndex,
    });
    rt.tokenBaseline = now; rt.lastTurnIndex = event.turnIndex;    
  } catch (e) { logError("nudge.turn_end", sessionId, { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }); }
}
const metric = markers.metric;
let finalMessages = messages;
if (config.nudges.perTurnDrift && metric && shouldNudge(metric, config) && !suppressCheck(metric, markers)) {
  finalMessages = injectNudge(messages, metric);   
}
rt.lastFiltered = finalMessages;
return { messages: finalMessages as unknown as ContextMessage[] };

```

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
- ❌ Do NOT call `pi.sendMessage` for the drift nudge — it is constructed inline in the filter copy (ephemeral).
- ❌ Do NOT use `getContextUsage().tokens` as the audit/total source — use `rt.lastFiltered` (D5 bookkeeping drift). (turn_end MAY fall back to getContextUsage only when no filtered view exists yet.)
- ❌ Do NOT replace result content — APPEND the reminder (the agent may need the data now).
- ❌ Do NOT clear pendingBloatHits in bloatReminderHandler — it accumulates and is read+cleared by turn_end.
- ❌ Do NOT add seq/schema/v/kind/ts to the appendTurnMetric arg — markers.ts stamps them (double-increment risk).
- ❌ Do NOT use a pure `ts <= metric.ts` suppress bound — it over-suppresses (one rewind ever → nudge never fires). Use the window.
- ❌ Do NOT invent `getRuntime` — this repo exports `runtime(arg)`.
- ❌ Do NOT modify index.ts or build the full `pi -p` smoke harness — those are P1.M5.T1.S1 / P1.M5.T3.S1.
- ❌ Do NOT import MarkersBundle into nudges.ts (cycle) — suppressCheck takes a structural {rewinds,shrinks} slice.
- ❌ Do NOT catch-all silently — log via logError with the sessionId + message; then fail-open (return nothing).
